widgets_values:
主体设定：<Subject 1> 是 <Picture 1> 画面左侧的男性，保留束起的发髻、短须与沉静的脸，宽大厚重、袍摆拖地的深色长袍，腰间一长一短两柄刀，右手长刀；<Subject 2> 是 <Picture 1> 画面右侧的男性，保留束起的发髻与清瘦的脸，深色衣装外肩披边缘毛糙的粗布披风，刀柄垂着绳穗，右手长刀；<Subject 3> 是 <Picture 1> 中的竹林空地：湿透的深色石板地、贴地的雾、两侧密集竹林。动作中两人的身份与整套服装不变。

概述：[参考生成] 风从左吹向右的竹林空地上，<Subject 1> 以长刀大弧守住身前一整圈刀圈，一步一刀向前压；<Subject 2> 要破开这道刀圈、贴进他一步之内。前者斩倒竹子封住后者的路线，后者借倒竹与弯竹的回弹两次突入，最后用刀柄撞落对方的长刀，两人在新位置继续交锋。

视觉：写实电影质感，低饱和青灰冷调，雾、湿地反光与竹林纵深层层分明，冷白天光从竹林顶端漫下勾出两人轮廓。两人都束发、衣着深色，以短须与厚袍、清瘦与披风区分，换位后也不混淆。刀刀相撞的火星是全片唯一的暖色，只在接触点一闪即灭，不是光效；竹子倒下的方向由斩击方向决定。空地右侧竹林边那根最粗的竹竿是固定地标，全片位置不变。无血，画面无文字水印。

[Shot 1] 贴地低位广景，从右侧竹林边穿过前景竹竿看向空地，雾被风拉成贴地的带子。<Subject 1> 从左侧压来，长刀一记大弧扫满身前；<Subject 2> 从右侧低身冲进，刀尖直取他的前膝。大弧的刀背砸在 <Subject 2> 刀身中段，把刀尖压进积水、划出一道水线，火星与水花同时炸起，<Subject 2> 被弹回刀圈外。他借回弹再冲，<Subject 1> 不砍人，横刀齐腰斩断他前方两根竹竿，竹子一前一后横倒封路；<Subject 2> 贴着湿石板从第一根竹子下方滑过，水花扇形铺开，第二根正从他头顶压下。

[Shot 2] 00:05.000 切绕行的全身机位，刚倒下的竹竿仍横在两人之间，那根最粗的竹竿在画面右侧。<Subject 2> 一脚蹬上正在倒下的竹竿，借倾倒变向跃起，从高处斜劈；<Subject 1> 双手横刀架在头顶，两刀相交处迸出火星，这一劈的分量把他压得单膝砸进积水。他借最低的重心整身一拧，肩膀由下往上撞进 <Subject 2> 胸口；<Subject 2> 倒飞出去，后背撞上那根最粗的竹竿，竹子整根弯到极限、竹叶倾泻。竹子回弹，把他整个人弹回来，正迎上 <Subject 1> 刚抡满的第二记大弧：两刀正撞，<Subject 2> 的刀几乎脱手，手腕被砸得向后折，身体被带着转了半圈。<Subject 1> 的长刀停在弧尾，厚袍慢半拍向后甩开，持刀手的另一侧露出空门。

[Shot 3] 00:10.000 切更低、更广的视角，地上横着被斩倒的竹竿与一道道水痕。<Subject 2> 顺着这半圈旋转压到最低，从还没收回的长刀下方钻进刀圈，贴到 <Subject 1> 持刀手的另一侧，两人左右换位。他反手用刀柄尾端猛撞长刀的护手根部：刀先被撞得一偏，才从 <Subject 1> 右手脱出，翻转着甩过 <Subject 2> 肩头，扎进那根最粗的竹竿，刀身震颤，竹叶纷落。<Subject 1> 左手已拔出腰间短刀横在身前，<Subject 2> 后撤半步沉低，刀尖对准他，两人随即再次移动脚步。扎在竹上的长刀保留在身后，两人的面孔、衣装与新的站位都清楚。

声音：风穿竹林的持续呼啸与竹叶沙沙声，湿石板上的脚步与滑行水声，长刀大弧沉厚的破风、快刀尖细的哨音，刀刀相撞的金属炸响，竹竿断裂的脆响与弯竹回弹的弹响，刀柄撞上护手的一记钝响，长刀扎进竹竿后的余颤。无对白或喊招式名。配乐以低沉太鼓与尺八渐紧，仅在长刀被撞脱手时加入一次重鼓。

<Subject 3> is an exotic beast ridden by <Subject 1> and <Subject 2>, entirely crimson red like burning charcoal, with both eyes radiating golden light, wind rising from its four hooves, moving as fast as flying, unlike any ordinary horse, made of other, crimson red in color, shown in <Picture 3>.

<Subject 5> is a pair of axes held by <Subject 1>, the axe blades pale gold in color with red silk wrapped around the handles, extremely sharp, creating a stunning display when charging into battle on <Subject 3>, made of metal, gold and red in color, shown in <Picture 5>.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a cinematic Chinese xianxia fantasy style with an ethereal atmosphere, ancient aesthetics, warm earth tones, drifting dust and floating light particles, and tense handheld camerawork that emphasizes the force of the duel.
[Shot 1] A medium shot from a right-45-degree side angle, positioned slightly left of center with a slight upward tilt and handheld shake, frames <Subject 1> (S1) on the left side of frame, facing screen-right, astride a <Subject 3> standing in the center-left of the battlefield; his face is taut, his snow-white eyebrows are raised, and as anger turns to a twisted laugh, he begins to heft a <Subject 5> in one hand. Across from him, <Subject 2> (S2), on the right side of frame and facing screen-left, sits astride another <Subject 3> several zhang away, gripping a <Subject 4> and watching <Subject 1> warily. <Subject 1> (S1) glares wide-eyed with fury, his facial muscles tight, and as his mouth twists into that angry smile, he says with his voice suddenly rising and each word ground out through clenched teeth, the final three words nearly one beat each, <d>[Chinese] 你皆是反贼逆党，敢如此大胆！</d>
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to an over-the-shoulder medium shot from behind <Subject 2>'s right side, eye-level with handheld shake. The back of <Subject 2>'s head and right shoulder enter the foreground at screen-right, his <Subject 3>'s haunch partially visible with its back to the camera, creating a blocking over-the-shoulder frame; in the left-middle ground, <Subject 1> faces screen-right and charges, swinging the <Subject 5> with a whistle of wind as he spurs his <Subject 3> into a violent dash from screen-left toward the right foreground, closing in on <Subject 2>.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot from a left-45-degree side angle, positioned right of center with handheld tracking shake that follows the action. <Subject 1>'s <Subject 3> charges to <Subject 2>'s side, and <Subject 1> raises the <Subject 5> high and chops down, the axe blade slicing the air with a sharp shriek. At the same moment, <Subject 2> turns from facing screen-left to a left profile, urgently spurring his <Subject 3> sideways toward the right rear of frame to evade, while bringing the <Subject 4> upward from below to meet the blow.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a close-up from a right-20-degree low angle, leaning toward <Subject 1>'s side with violent handheld shaking. In the left foreground, <Subject 1> faces screen-right, roaring like thunder as the blade of the <Subject 5> crashes against the <Subject 4>; in the right foreground, <Subject 2> faces screen-left, also roaring, his <Subject 4> rising to meet the axe blade, his body recoiling slightly at the impact while dust erupts from the ground around them.
[Shot 5] At 00:08.000, the shot cuts to a wide shot from a left-60-degree side angle, slightly high, with handheld shake. In the left-middle ground, <Subject 1> faces screen-right, wheeling his <Subject 3> in a circling retreat from screen-left toward the right rear, stirring up dust; in the right-middle ground, <Subject 2> faces screen-left, urging his <Subject 3> in a circling maneuver from screen-right toward the left rear, holding the <Subject 4> horizontally in a defensive guard.
[Shot 6] At 00:10.000, the shot cuts to a medium shot from a right-45-degree side angle, centered, with handheld shake and dust filling the air. Through the swirling dust, <Subject 1> in the left-middle ground faces screen-right and charges again, his <Subject 5> rising for another strike; <Subject 2> in the right-middle ground faces screen-left and spurs his <Subject 3> forward, swinging the <Subject 4> to meet him. The two beasts wheel and circle; at the instant of their crossing, the ground dust is shaken up again, and the final frame ends at 00:12.000 with both warriors locked in the stinging haze.

overall_soundscape:
Dust-laden battlefield wind hisses continuously across the open ground; the thunderous clash of axe and club rings out at the moment of impact, followed by the sharp ringing of metal-on-metal; the low guttural snarl of the crimson beasts rumbles beneath the wind as hooves pound and churn the earth.
